rationale: The protected phrasing held: “differences were associated with restoration status” became “Both contrasts were associated with restoration status,” preserving noncausal strength. All values, decimal places, CI bounds, and citations were retained. However, the model claim changed without authorization from canopy cover “predicted lower nitrate concentration” to “was associated with lower nitrate concentration,” weakening its epistemic verb. The water-depth description also shifted from a “smaller positive association” to “slightly higher nitrate concentration,” changing what is characterized as small.
